# Operator operator -

#### operator -(Vector3D)

Negates a vector.

##### Declaration

```
public static Vector3D operator -(Vector3D inVector)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Vector3D |  inVector |  Vector to negate.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  Vector3D |  Negated vector.  |
